name: Punisher 2099

abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Disintegration: Aktifken doğrudan hasar verir; etkilenen şampiyonun güç kazanım oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Lock: Hedefin herhangi bir yolla güç kazanmasını engeller.

signatureAbility:
Retribution 2099
A last-minute upgrade to the Punisher's arsenal allows him to begin each fight with an additional 25% charge in his Nano-Tech Battery and also gains a new Nano-Tech Automatic Effect.
Opponent hits 3 Bars of Power: 40% of the Battery is drained to drain 0.6 Bars of Power and inflict a Power Lock Debuff for [2 - 10] seconds.

abilitySections.title: Nano-Tech - Charging
content: The Nano-Tech Battery begins the fight with 40% of max charge.
Every 3.5 seconds, the Battery triggers a recharge.
If the opponent has 0 Buffs, the Battery recharges 9%.
If the opponent has 1 Buff, the Battery recharges 7%.
If the opponent has 2 or more Buffs, the Battery recharges 4%.

abilitySections.title: Nano-Tech -
content: Opponent activates a Regeneration Buff: 15% of the Battery is drained to infect the opponent with nano-inhibitors and Heal Block them for 10 seconds. This Debuff automatically reapplies itself if a Regeneration Buff is still active when it expires.

Punisher drops below 15% Health: the Battery is drained entirely to grant a Regeneration Buff lasting 10 seconds and healing up to [45,316.6] Health based on how full the Battery was. This effect can only activate once per fight.
Punisher lands a Heavy Attack: 10% of the Battery is drained to inflict a 1.5 second Stun Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Nano-Tech - Overdrive
content: When the Battery hits 100%, it immediately goes into Overdrive and continually drains. It also cannot recharge until it is drained entirely and switches back to recharge mode.
While in Overdrive: Punisher gains +[15,838.5] Attack Rating and his attacks cause his opponent to gain 90% less Power.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The Punisher momentarily switches his battery into Overcharge mode, gaining 20% charge over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 15% of the Battery is drained to activate Auto-Targeting. Auto-Target attacks cannot trigger a Passive Evade and gain [1,833.33] additional Critical Rating.

Grenade Launcher: 100% chance to inflict a stacking Armor Break Debuff removing an Armor Up and reducing Armor Rating by [4,125] for 15 seconds. If the Battery has at least 10% charge, it expends that amount to double the duration of this Armor Break.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 40% of the Battery is drained, to inflict a non-stacking 90% potency Disintegration Debuff, dealing [23,229.8] Direct Damage over 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Retribution 2099
content: A last-minute upgrade to the Punisher's arsenal allows him to begin each fight with an additional 25% charge in his Nano-Tech Battery and also gains a new Nano-Tech Automatic Effect.
Opponent hits 3 Bars of Power: 40% of the Battery is drained to drain 0.6 Bars of Power and inflict a Power Lock Debuff for [2 - 10] seconds.
